response.sql: WITH order_avgs AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) as avg_unfilled FROM orderexecutions WHERE remaincount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ordersmark), overall_avg_val AS (SELECT AVG(remaincount) as overall_avg FROM orderexecutions WHERE remaincount IS NOT NULL), above_overall AS (SELECT oa.ordersmark, oa.avg_unfilled FROM order_avgs oa, overall_avg_val ov WHERE oa.avg_unfilled > ov.overall_avg), group_avg_val AS (SELECT AVG(avg_unfilled) as group_avg FROM above_overall), final_filtered AS (SELECT ao.ordersmark, ao.avg_unfilled FROM above_overall ao, group_avg_val ga WHERE ao.avg_unfilled > ga.group_avg) SELECT AVG(ff.avg_unfilled), AVG(ff.avg_unfilled - ov.overall_avg), AVG(ff.avg_unfilled - ga.group_avg) FROM final_filtered ff CROSS JOIN overall_avg_val ov CROSS JOIN group_avg_val ga

assumptions.assumption: The group's own average is the unweighted average of per-order averages (the mean of each order's AVG(remaincount)), not the weighted average of all remaincount values across executions in the group.

alternatives.interpretation: The group's own average is the weighted average of all remaincount values across all executions in the above-overall group (consistent with how the overall average is computed).
